review_method: Static source review of the exact R1-to-R2 diff, retaining the prior complete runner/CLI/transport review. No NN or network execution and no benchmark-input changes.

resolved_blocking.resolution: The runner now separately sums child tracking_seconds for each serial phase and takes the maximum child tracking_seconds for each parallel phase, then sums each condition and reports approximate_tracking_window_speedup. The recommendation requires both this ratio and the end-to-end ratio to exceed1.10, plus byte-equal predictions. It explicitly states that model loading is excluded and no common launch barrier exists.

verified_correct: R2 changes only the additional tracking-window calculation, its output/scope text, and the stricter adoption predicate.
Both timing ratios compare the same2668 frames per condition. End-to-end phase duration remains unchanged and includes startup through actual child completion/receipt validation.

Each phase runs the same four complete DEV videos with657+677=1334 frames, same epoch1 checkpoint and fixed shard3/shard33 inputs. All eight actual child exit codes must be0 before successful completion.
Prediction byte equality is still checked across serial1, parallel1, parallel2 and serial2, and remains necessary for adoption.
GPU3 preflight, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3, non-temperature/non-power resource sampling, unique profile output directory and own-child cleanup are unchanged.
No production source or checkpoint write, optimizer update, task restart, external model call, or formal-metric claim was added.
Fixed work is finite; no unsupported hard-runtime or timeout requirement is imposed.
interpretation_limits: PASS authorizes the scoped source implementation for the controlled benchmark; it is not a measured throughput or memory-adequacy result.

The tracking-window ratio is an approximation from child durations without synchronized starts. It includes video initialization, decoding, tracking, scoring and output writes rather than only GPU computation.

The operator still needs the actual successful receipts, measured memory headroom, both timing ratios and prediction agreement before increasing production concurrency. Four DEV videos cannot establish a full98 performance guarantee.
GPU2's newly launched E2 shard1 is parent-reported stable background work; this review did not query remote state. The benchmark runner launches only on GPU3.
